selected_evidence.summary: Shows AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 before and after, with AIDE 0.19.2 installed from AppStream.
Shows the effective integrity rule, successful initialization, 1,189 baseline entries, database checksum, and a clean check.

selected_evidence.requirement: Later changes are identified and reported
selected_evidence.summary: AIDE detects an added /etc file and a SHA-512/size change to an existing file; the reporting service records clean scheduled-check summaries.
Final scan reports no differences across 1,189 entries; timer is enabled and active, system state is running, and failed-unit count is zero.
Captures healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered system/database/timer, and metadata-only false positives that led to rule refinement.

commands.command:
cp -a /etc/aide.conf /var/lib/aide/aide.conf.vendor
cat > /etc/aide.conf <<'AIDE_CONFIG_EOF'
@@define DBDIR /var/lib/aide
database_in=file:@@{DBDIR}/aide.db.gz
database_out=file:@@{DBDIR}/aide.db.new.gz
gzip_dbout=yes
database_attrs=H
log_level=warning
report_level=changed_attributes
report_format=plain
report_grouped=yes
report_summarize_changes=yes
report_quiet=no
report_url=stdout
NORMAL = p+i+n+u+g+s+b+m+c+acl+selinux+xattrs+sha512
/etc NORMAL
AIDE_CONFIG_EOF
cat > /usr/local/sbin/aide-check-etc <<'AIDE_SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
log=/var/log/aide/aide-check.log
tmp=$(mktemp /var/log/aide/aide-check.XXXXXX) || exit 8
/usr/sbin/aide --config=/etc/aide.conf --check >"$tmp" 2>&1
rc=$?
{
  printf '\n===== %s AIDE /etc check exit=%s =====\n' "$(date --iso-8601=seconds)" "$rc"
  cat "$tmp"
} >> "$log"
cat "$tmp"
rm -f "$tmp"
if [ "$rc" -le 7 ]; then
  exit 0
fi
exit "$rc"
AIDE_SCRIPT_EOF
chmod 0750 /usr/local/sbin/aide-check-etc
cat > /etc/systemd/system/aide-check.service <<'AIDE_SERVICE_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Check /etc against the AIDE integrity baseline
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/aide-check-etc
AIDE_SERVICE_EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/aide-check.timer <<'AIDE_TIMER_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Daily AIDE integrity check for /etc

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=15m
Unit=aide-check.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
AIDE_TIMER_EOF
/usr/sbin/aide --config=/etc/aide.conf --config-check
systemctl daemon-reload
/usr/sbin/aide --config=/etc/aide.conf --init
